title: 13 Dead and 13 Thought Trapped in Indonesian Mine After Heavy Rain

caption: A photo released by Indonesia’s National Search and Rescue Agency of rescuers at the site where miners are believed trapped in an unauthorized gold mine in Bogor, West Java, Indonesia, on Wednesday.

title: How Birds With GPS and Audio Sensors Track Hidden Fishing Boats
summary: Researchers are using seabirds equipped with GPS and audio gear to detect vessels that operate with no tracking signals and to assess the environmental hazards they pose.

title: Lured by High Salaries, Some Brazilians Were Duped Into Fighting for Russia

title: El Salvador’s Nayib Bukele Elates Haiti With Fight Against Gangs

title: The Unbearable Heat of Delhi’s Summer Nights

title: Hong Kong Grieves Fire Victims Under Watchful Eye of Authorities
